title: Fluent 2 UI preset configuration (fluent.config.json)
description: User-authored design presets for building AND adopting Microsoft Fluent 2 (Fluent UI 2.0) UIs across Web (React v9 / Web Components), Power BI, and Power Platform. Every field maps to concrete Fluent 2 design tokens or component props. See research/config-design.md for the full field-to-token mapping and rationale.

$schema.title: Schema reference
$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON Schema so editors (VS Code) provide validation and IntelliSense.

version.title: Config version
version.description: Version of the fluent.config schema this file targets. Lets tools evolve the format safely.

iconStyle.title: Icon style
iconStyle.description: Default @fluentui/react-icons variant. 'regular' for wayfinding and most UI; 'filled' for selected/emphasis states. Maps to the icon component name suffix (e.g. Home24Regular vs Home24Filled).

preferences.title: Freeform preferences
preferences.description: Escape hatch for team-specific presets not covered by the schema. Not strictly validated; the only object where additional keys are allowed.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Freeform prose describing design intent, brand voice, constraints, or reference links.

hexColor.description: A 6-digit hex color, with or without a leading '#'.

cornerRadius.title: Corner radius preset
cornerRadius.description: Maps to a Fluent 2 borderRadius token: sharp=borderRadiusNone (0px); small=borderRadiusSmall (2px); medium=borderRadiusMedium (4px, Fluent control default); large=borderRadiusLarge (6px); xlarge=borderRadiusXLarge (8px, Fluent card default); pill=borderRadiusCircular (9999px).

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Brand color inputs that drive the Fluent 2 BrandVariants ramp and createLightTheme / createDarkTheme.

color.title: Brand color
color.description: Primary brand color (hex). Becomes BrandVariants slot 80 and seeds the 16-slot ramp (via fluent_generate_theme). Drives colorBrandBackground, colorBrandForeground1, colorCompoundBrandForeground1, colorBrandStroke1, and the rest of the colorBrand* tokens. Omit to use the Fluent default brand (#0f6cbd, i.e. webLightTheme).

name.title: Theme identifier
name.description: Valid JS identifier used to name the exported theme variables (matches the fluent_generate_theme 'name' argument).

ramp.title: BrandVariants ramp override
ramp.description: Optional explicit 16-slot BrandVariants ramp (keys 10..160). Overrides or patches the ramp generated from 'color'. Supply all 16 slots to fully replace it; a partial set patches individual slots. Feeds createLightTheme / createDarkTheme and the --colorBrandNN CSS variables.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Color scheme and base theme selection. Resolves which set of Fluent 2 semantic color tokens is applied.

mode.title: Color mode
mode.description: light -> createLightTheme / webLightTheme; dark -> createDarkTheme / webDarkTheme; system -> follow the OS prefers-color-scheme. Selects the semanticLight vs semanticDark token values.

base.title: Base theme family
base.description: Fluent base theme. web -> webLightTheme / webDarkTheme; teams -> teamsLightTheme / teamsDarkTheme / teamsHighContrastTheme.

highContrast.title: Support high contrast
highContrast.description: When true, agents also wire up Windows High Contrast: teamsHighContrastTheme (the semanticHighContrast token values) and @media (forced-colors: active). Don't hardcode colors that would override it.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: Font family and size inputs. Overrides the Fluent type ramp tokens.

fontFamily.title: Base font family
fontFamily.description: Overrides the fontFamilyBase token; applied to every type-ramp style (caption/body/subtitle/title/display).
fontFamily.default: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web (West European)', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif

monospaceFontFamily.title: Monospace font family
monospaceFontFamily.description: Overrides the fontFamilyMonospace token (code, numeric-tabular contexts).

baseSize.title: Base font size (px)
baseSize.description: Body font size in px. Maps to fontSizeBase300 (Fluent default 14px) and anchors the fontSizeBase* ramp.

scale.title: Type scale multiplier
scale.description: Advisory multiplier applied across the fontSizeBase*/fontSizeHero* ramp and matching lineHeight* tokens. NOTE: Fluent's ramp is a fixed, discrete set; a value other than 1 is applied app-side (Fluent has no native global type-scale multiplier).

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: Corner-radius personality, mapped to Fluent borderRadius* tokens. Controls and cards can differ.

cornerRadius.title: Global corner radius
cornerRadius.description: Overall roundness personality. Used as the control radius when 'control' is omitted, and as the basis for 'card' (one step rounder).

control.title: Control corner radius
control.description: Corner radius for interactive controls (Button, Input, Menu, Dropdown). Fluent default medium=borderRadiusMedium (4px). Maps to the Fluent v9 Button 'shape' prop: sharp->square, pill->circular, otherwise rounded with the mapped borderRadius token.

card.title: Card corner radius
card.description: Corner radius for cards and larger surfaces. Fluent default xlarge=borderRadiusXLarge (8px).

density.title: Size / density
density.description: Default control size and layout spacing rhythm.

controlSize.title: Default control size
controlSize.description: Default Fluent component 'size' prop (Button, Input, Dropdown, etc.). Approximate control heights: small=24px, medium=32px, large=40px.

spacing.title: Spacing rhythm
spacing.description: Layout spacing density expressed with Fluent spacing tokens. compact ~ spacingVerticalS (8px) / spacingHorizontalSNudge (6px); comfortable ~ spacingVerticalM/spacingHorizontalM (12px); spacious ~ spacingVerticalL (16px) / spacingHorizontalXL (20px). NOTE: Fluent has no single global density prop; agents realize density by choosing the control 'size' plus these spacing tokens.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Accessibility targets that agents enforce and that fluent-design-review / fluent_accessibility_checklist validate against.

targetLevel.title: WCAG conformance target
targetLevel.description: WCAG 2.2 conformance target. Fluent 2 components meet or exceed AA out of the box.

minTargetSize.title: Minimum target size (px)
minTargetSize.description: Minimum pointer target size in CSS px. 24 = WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), Level AA; 44 = WCAG 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced), Level AAA. Drives the default control 'size' / minimum hit area.

minContrast.title: Minimum text contrast
minContrast.description: Minimum contrast ratio for normal text. WCAG 1.4.3 (AA) = 4.5:1; WCAG 1.4.6 (AAA) = 7:1. Checked against colorNeutralForeground* on colorNeutralBackground* and text on colorBrandBackground.

minContrastLargeText.title: Minimum large-text contrast
minContrastLargeText.description: Minimum contrast for large text (>= 18.5px bold or >= 24px regular). WCAG AA = 3:1.

minContrastNonText.title: Minimum non-text contrast
minContrastNonText.description: Minimum contrast for icons, control borders, focus indicators, and state. WCAG 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast = 3:1.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion policy
reducedMotion.description: respect = honor prefers-reduced-motion; reduce = always minimize animation; allow = never reduce. Maps to the Fluent duration* / curve* motion tokens (reduced -> near-zero durations / no non-essential motion).

forcedColors.title: Forced colors policy
forcedColors.description: respect = support Windows High Contrast via @media (forced-colors: active) and the semanticHighContrast token set; off = opt out (not recommended).

targets.title: Build / adoption targets
targets.description: Which Fluent 2 surfaces to build or adopt for. Routes to MCP tools: web-react -> fluent_generate_code (react); web-components -> fluent_generate_code (webcomponents); powerbi -> fluent_generate_powerbi_theme / fluent_scaffold_pbip; powerapps/powerpages/pcf -> fluent_powerplatform_guidance.

migration.title: Migration
migration.description: Adoption context when introducing Fluent 2 into an existing app or report.

from.title: Migrating from
from.description: Existing design system. Maps to a fluent_migration_guidance scenario: fluent-v8 -> v8-to-v9; mui/bootstrap/antd/chakra -> from-design-system; css -> hardcoded-to-tokens; none -> greenfield (no migration).

strategy.title: Adoption strategy
strategy.description: incremental / side-by-side = add FluentProvider at a subtree boundary and migrate screen-by-screen; greenfield = a fresh Fluent 2 build.

content.title: Content design
content.description: Copy conventions that shape generated labels, headings, and button text.

capitalization.title: Capitalization
capitalization.description: Label/heading/button casing. Fluent content design: sentence-case for Windows, Android, and web; title-case for iOS and macOS.

voice.title: Voice & tone
voice.description: Freeform tone/voice notes for generated copy (e.g., 'friendly, concise, second person, present tense, active voice').
